Quỳnh Thi

Lifestyle-first beauty for Vietnam's young women

Quỳnh Thi blends makeup looks, skincare tips, self-care vlogs and candid storytelling into one lifestyle-led beauty channel. Her personality-first take on trends has earned 2.86M subscribers and 781M views from just 121 videos, the largest audience in this lineup. A strong fit for skincare, cosmetics, personal care and youth lifestyle brands that want mass reach.

Hà Linh Official

Straight-talking cosmetics reviews before you buy

Hà Linh Official puts makeup and skincare to the test, from budget drugstore picks to Chinese and Korean color cosmetics, with ingredient-led breakdowns and clear verdicts on camera. Shoppers tune in before they buy, which has driven 405M lifetime views across 2.22M subscribers. Best fit for skincare, color cosmetics, e-commerce marketplaces, beauty retail and new product launches.

Trinh Phạm

A decade of trusted skincare picks and beauty favorites

Trinh Phạm has been on YouTube since 2011 and is best known for her yearly Best of Beauty roundups and budget-smart picks like skincare under 500K VND. Her warm, explanatory style has built 1.2M subscribers and 185M views across 840 videos. A natural fit for skincare, cosmetics, haircare, mother-and-baby and lifestyle brands seeking credible, long-form endorsement.

Changmakeup

The lipstick expert who built her own beauty brand

Changmakeup made her name with detailed lipstick swatches and reviews, then launched her own cosmetics label, OFÉLIA, in 2016. She was the first Vietnamese female beauty blogger to earn YouTube's Gold Play Button, and her library of 238 videos has drawn 194M views. Ideal for lip and color cosmetics, beauty retail and founder-led brand storytelling.

Lie Makeup

Viral makeup challenges built for the Shorts era

Lie Makeup turns makeup into a show: blind-bag challenges, random-color looks, lipstick-only faces and bold character transformations, each cut as a quick Shorts reveal. That format scales well, with 897K subscribers and 720M lifetime views from 721 uploads since 2017. A strong fit for color cosmetics, beauty retail, Shorts-first launches, creative tie-ins and youth lifestyle brands.
